title: Long Keyturn Trip Booking Reservations: How the Line Price for a Mileage Top-Up Is Taken
content:
On a Keyturn Trip Booking whose reserved period runs for 60 days or more, the line price for a top-up of included miles is taken on a different basis from the one used on shorter reservations, and which of the two long-period bases applies turns on the size of the top-up.

**Where the reserved period runs for 60 days or more and the top-up added 2000 miles or more**, the line price is the block price, less the volume concession, apportioned over the priced block by the mile and charged for each mile the top-up added. Every mile is priced and no part block is rounded up.

**Where the reserved period runs for 60 days or more and the top-up added fewer than 2000 miles**, the line price is the block price, less the volume concession, charged for each whole priced block the top-up added and nothing for the miles left over. The part block is dropped rather than rounded up.

**In every other case** the line price is the block price, less the volume concession, charged for each priced block the top-up added, a part block counting as a whole block.

### The three bases compared

| Reserved period | Miles the top-up added | What is charged for |
|---|---|---|
| 60 days or more | 2000 or more | Each mile, at the block price less the concession apportioned over the priced block by the mile. |
| 60 days or more | Fewer than 2000 | Each whole priced block; nothing for the miles left over. |
| Fewer than 60 days | Any | Each priced block, a part block counting as a whole block. |

The length of the reserved period is counted from the first day of that period to the last, both days counted, and 60 days is reached rather than passed. The mile figure is likewise reached rather than passed: a top-up of exactly 2000 miles on a long reserved period is priced by the mile.

### Worked on hypothetical figures

*Hypothetical: a reserved period of 80 days, a top-up adding 2300 miles, a block price less concession of 137.00 USD for a priced block of 500 miles.* The first basis governs. Apportioned over the priced block by the mile, that is 0.274 USD for each mile, and 2300 miles gives a line price of 630.20 USD.

*Hypothetical: the same reserved period, a top-up adding 1700 miles.* The second basis governs. Seventeen hundred miles is 3 whole priced blocks with 200 miles left over; the whole blocks are charged for at 137.00 USD each, giving 411.00 USD, and the 200 miles left over are charged nothing.

*Hypothetical: a reserved period of 35 days, a top-up adding 1700 miles.* The third basis governs. Three whole blocks and a part block make 4 priced blocks at 137.00 USD each, giving 548.00 USD.
